def assign_norrec_diffs_from_dict(df, diff_dict):
    """Compute and write the difference between normal and reciprocal values
    for all columns specified in the diff_dict parameter.

    Note that the DataFrame is directly written to. That is, it is changed
    during the call of this function. No need to use the returned object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df: pandas.DataFrame
        Dataframe containing the data
    diff_dict: dict
        dictionary of columns to compute differences for.

    Returns
    -------
    None
    """
    for col, rec_col in diff_dict.items():
        df[f"{col}_diff"] = df[col] - df[f"{rec_col}_rec"]
